name: com.netsync.unity
description: Unity adapter for the NetSync networking core: MonoBehaviour integration, main-thread events and Vector/Quaternion serialization. The core (com.netsync.core) is installed with it: TCP and UDP channels, reliable UDP, authentication and encryption, relay with hole punching, time sync, LAN discovery.

samples.description: LAN chat with typed messages over the reliable TCP channel.
Server-authoritative transform sync over sequenced UDP, interpolated on the shared server clock.
Encrypted login with server-side approval; ECDH with a pinned identity where the runtime supports it, otherwise a pre-shared key.
LAN server list with announcements and connectionless queries for players and ping.
A file of any size on a low-priority channel next to real-time traffic.
Player-hosted rooms through a relay by room code, with UDP hole punching.
